newsitem.title: USA: Med/Waste to buy stake in Biomedical.
newsitem.headline: Med/Waste to buy stake in Biomedical.

text.p: Med/Waste Inc on Monday said it agreed to buy 40 percent of Biomedical Waste Systems as part of a reorganization of Biomedical.
Biomedical, which owns a medical waste incineration facility, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection two years ago, Med/Waste said.

As plan funder, Med/Waste would invest $2 million to purchase 1.5 million shares of newly issued Biomed capital stock and up to a maximum of 3.75 million shares of newly issued capital common stock contemplated under the plan of reorganization, the company said.
Under the terms of the agreement, Med/Waste would have the right to name five of the eight members of the board of directors, Med/Waste said.

Med/Waste said it would acquire five-year warrants to purchase up to 1 million additional shares of newly issued Biomed capital stock at $2.00 per share, which if exercised, would give it more than 50 percent ownership of Biomed.
The deal is conditioned upon completion of due diligence by Med/Waste and approvals by Biomed creditors and the Bankruptcy Court of the Southern District of New York, Med/Waste said.
Also, under the plan funding agreement, Biomed must secure $6.o million in long-term debt financing, the company said.

If the plan of reorganization is approved by the court and creditors, long-term financing is secured and the plan is funded by Med/Waste, all of the current common stock will be canceled, Med/Waste said.
The present timetable calls for a closing of the transaction no later than August 1.
